name: Atlanta Hartsfield-Jackson International
subtitle: Stand assignment and push control for Concourses T, A-F (Ramps 1-9)
source: Stand positions and headings, taxilanes, aprons and buildings from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL); gate list, ramp areas, ramp control frequencies, ramp entry points and ramp hold spots from the Jeppesen 10-9B and 10-9C (user-supplied). The chart frame is generated: north up, 1.5 m per pixel, linear in lat/lon. Each gate stand is 20 m back from the terminal end of its OSM lead-in line. Gates renumbered to match 10-9B where OSM differs: Concourse B west OSM B22/B24/B26/B28 are the chart's B24/B26/B28/B30; Concourse D west OSM D38/D34/D32 are D40A/D38/D36 and OSM D16/D14 are D18/D16; Concourse D east OSM D13/D11 are D17/D15. OSM lines not on the chart are left out (OSM D15, D24, D27, D29, D23A, D35A, T13A, T16A, E8A, E30A, E36A, E15A-E18A). A lines beside their base line are one stand: T1/A, T2/A, E3/A, E27/A, E33/A, F3/A. E37 has no OSM line and sits 25 m north of its gate node; F12A has none and sits midway between F12 and F14.

airlines.name: Frontier, Spirit, JetBlue, Alaska, Air Canada and other domestic carriers

airlinesSource: Approximate, from airport guides: Delta mainline on T, A and B (international on E and F), Delta Connection on B and C, Southwest on C, American and United on T and D, other domestic carriers on D, foreign carriers on E and F. Worth checking against current use.
notes: Ramp control by ramp: Ramp 1 131.45, Ramp 2 131.85, Ramp 3 129.275, Ramp 4 130.075, Ramp 5 129.375, Ramp 6 131.375, Ramp 8 128.975, Ramp 9 131.875.
Each ramp between two concourses has a north (N) and south (S) entry point; Ramp 6 has 6N, 6E and 6S, Ramp 8 has 8W and 8S, Ramp 9 has 9S.
Ramp hold spots 1-7 (diamonds on 10-9B) are on taxiway D between Concourses E and F and by the Group VI pads east of F.
Taxiway D between taxiways G and L is a non-movement area worked by Ramp Control 131.375.
During deice operations: Ramp 6N/7 uses 129.25 for operations and Ramp Control; Ramp 6S uses 131.375.
Runway incursion hot spots HS1 and HS2: see the airport's 10-9A.
